hero-subtitle: KIJ is a multi-agent AI platform that analyzes, guides, and supports — whether you are an organization, a professional, or a person in difficulty.
module-subtitle: Same AI architecture, two concrete applications — and the AND logic: always both.
module1-desc: Document analysis, report generation, linguistic correction, monitoring, patents, and professional deliverables — orchestrated by 20 specialized agents.
module1-feat1-desc: CVs, contracts, reports, invoices, images, tables
module2-desc: Support for people in vulnerable situations: employment, housing, health, rights, training, and psychosocial support — without judgment, with dignity.
module2-feat2-desc: Drafted and personalized according to the situation
work-subtitle: From file deposit or request to final report — automatically.
work-step1-desc: The user sends a file, a question, or fills out a form. n8n receives and routes it automatically.
work-step2-desc: Claude corrects the request, Gemini reads heavy files, Perplexity verifies recent information.
work-step3-desc: The orchestrator activates the right agents (legal, linguistic, employment, quality...) according to the detected content.
work-step4-desc: Supabase stores everything. The final report is delivered by email, PDF, or dashboard — with a confidence level.
tech-subtitle: Eight complementary tools, an AND logic: all activated according to need.
cta-subtitle: Start with the free stack. Add paid tools when limits are reached.
footer-desc: Multi-agent AI platform for intelligent analysis, humanitarian aid, and professional integration.
